caption:
Global Metadata: A sunny Neapolitan Italian folk song, 104 BPM, warm and lyrical. Led by the mandolin with bright crisp plucks, joined by an accordion, an acoustic guitar and a light tambourine. A warm male voice sings a melodic Italian verse, the mandolin answers with quick bright phrases, and the ensemble plays a lively refrain. Production profile: warm, close Mediterranean folk recording, bright crisp mandolin, rich accordion, studio mastering with generous dynamic range.

Vocal Details: One lead voice, a warm expressive male singer in Italian, natural, no auto-tune, clear and unforced. No falsetto, no backing choir, no spoken dialogue. The voice is absent in the instrumental breaks.

Arrangement: Intro, the mandolin plays a bright quick motif over the accordion and guitar. Verse one, the warm male voice sings a melodic Italian verse, the mandolin answers. Refrain, the ensemble plays a lively refrain with the voice. Verse two, back to the melodic verse. Outro, a bright crisp ending on the mandolin.
lyrics:
[Intro]
Mandolin bright quick motif, accordion and guitar

[Verse 1]
Sole sul mare, voglio cantare
la mandola suona per noi
quando ti vedo, il cuore si accende
amore mio, resta qui

[Refrain]
Tra la la, la bella notte
sotto le stelle, balla con me
tra la la, dolce mare
i nostri cuori in armonia

[Verse 2]
Vento di sud, profumo di fiori
canta la notte per noi

[Outro]
Bright crisp mandolin ending
